name: multiview-blockout-to-real
description: Turn any grey 3D scene (a .blend, a mesh file, a JSON scene spec or an idea) into the same scene textured from several calibrated views of one generated photoreal multi-view sheet: exact clay views and passes from N cameras, one multi-reference image edit, per-view refinement with a fixed acceptance rule, a measured cross-view consistency score, visibility-aware fusion into each object's own UV atlas scored by leave-one-view-out and seam visibility, and two outputs: a baked-appearance diagnostic .blend and an editable, relightable PBR .blend, with coverage reported as measured versus inferred.
